d:
I write mostly ENF/CMNF stories here
https://storiesonline.net/a/eddie-davidson

Like this site, it's largely free. I am not about putting my stuff behind a paywall. It's an adult story site and I've been there for over a decade. I use AI to help illustrate my stories. However, I also use photoshop, caption, editing tools, upscale, and polish to make them much better.

I often make about 20-30 pictures for everyone that I post. There are sometimes more. There are some really good ones that I just didn't need. I decided to see if there was any interest here in them. These are all original. Yes, I understand AI has a stigma but it's a tool that allows someone like me to bring a mental image to life and it takes work. I spend hours on these. I am not going to say I am as talented as a true artist. I am just a dirty old man, who can't fucking draw but wishes he could.

Many of my stories feature an easter egg of myself included. In this first batch I channel my inner Indian and introduce Thakri. Thakri is definitely a pervert and that is what his name means in Hindi. I like to think If I were lucky enough to be born in India, I would have turned out like him. Usually, you'll also find me on television sets in a cheap set shilling for "Fast Eddie's Bail Bounds and Discount Ribs" with the slogan "Sticky Fingers and Fast Release" or as a knock off Colonel Sanders called Colonel Davidson in downtown Tokyo.

Invented a "Sailor Moo" character and envisioned a hybrid cow/sailor moon anime series about a big breasted blonde that gains her power through butt touches. Then I postulated what it would be like if the marketing company brought a bunch of American women over to advertise it and gave them breast enlargement but expected them to stay and earn them.

The story I made those pictures for wasn't even about that particular scenario. I have fun creating the pictures. I hope you enjoy them. If you do not, there is always "Click Next".

Pictures with out captions may not be fully optimized.
